description: The Romanian National Administration Apele Române publishes the flood hazard maps of the first and second cycles of the EU Floods Directive on its public GIS portal, as an ArcGIS web experience and as map and vector tile services. The cycle 2 map service has four layers: 10-year, 100-year, 100-year with climate change and 1,000 or 500-year flood hazard, and it allows map, query and data operations; cycle 1 hazard is a separate service. The portal also links a revision viewer of cycle 1 and 2 hazard and risk maps. Coverage is Romania. The services are free to view and query without login. Caveats: the portal states no licence and the services carry no description or copyright text, so terms of reuse must be asked of ANAR; the layer names are the only schema read. Simulation uses: flood exposure of water, drainage and other infrastructure and adaptation planning. Related records: the Romanian national dam register (data-romania-rebar-national-dam-register) and Luxembourg flood hazard maps (data-luxembourg-flood-and-heavy-rainfall-hazard-maps).
